title: peakmark.toml
description: The modules peakmark gates, their budgets and their scenarios. Paths are relative to this file. Reference: https://casoon.github.io/peakmark/docs/reference/configuration/

tolerance.description: Growth over the baseline below this fraction is not reported. Default "1%".

scenario_timeout.description: How long a scenario may run before peakmark stops it, for every scenario that sets no `timeout`. Default "60s"; must be longer than zero.

module.description: A WebAssembly module to gate. Each name once.

scenario.description: A script that drives a module in Node.js and measures its memory.

size.description: Bytes: a plain number in a string, or a number with B, kB, MB, GB, KiB, MiB or GiB, such as "170 kB" or "26 MiB".

duration.description: A duration with ms, s or m, such as "500ms", "30s" or "2m".

signature.description: A function signature as `check --details` prints it, such as "(i32, i32) -> i32". Spaces do not matter.

name.description: The name used in reports, in the baseline and by `accept`.

artifact.description: The .wasm file you ship; for wasm-bindgen, the processed pkg/*_bg.wasm.

glue.description: The wasm-bindgen JavaScript glue, loaded as an ES module.

budget.description: Limits that fail the check when exceeded. A missing value is not gated.

peak_memory.description: Highest linear memory capacity after a scenario. Needs a scenario for the module.

growth_per_run.description: What each run after the first may add to linear memory. Needs a scenario with repeat >= 2.

policy.description: Compatibility rules for the inventory. Breaking one fails the check; accepting the baseline does not waive it.

signature.description: If given, the export must be a function with exactly this signature.

allow_imports.description: The only imports the module may have; [] allows none.

signature.description: If given, only a function of this signature is allowed.

allow_features.description: The only features the binary may need; [] allows none.

file.description: The ES module whose default export runs once per repeat. Once per module: it is the scenario's identity in the baseline.

repeat.description: How often the function runs on one instance. Default 1.

timeout.description: This scenario's deadline, replacing scenario_timeout. Must be longer than zero.
